{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-conv-search（对话内文本搜索）— in-conversation text search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Ctrl+F, match case, whole word, streaming-aware)","id":"gh:1333931421","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-conv-search","slug":"beijingwahw/dsh-conv-search","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","in-conversation-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-conv-search（对话内文本搜索）— in-conversation text search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Ctrl+F, match cas"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"e, whole word, streaming-aware)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-conv-search（对话内文本搜索）"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"In-conversation text search for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — the `Ctrl+F` you already know, scoped "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"to the current chat session. A floating search bar highlights every match in the rendered transcript"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" and walks between them, without touching a single line of harness core code."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Problems it solves"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Long sessions are unsearchable**: the browser's native find searches the whole page (sidebar, co"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"mposer, chrome) and cannot follow a conversation that keeps streaming. This plugin searches only the"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" active conversation scrollport and stays in sync while the model is still writing.
- **No way to ju"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"mp between occurrences**: native find gives no "n / total" navigation. This plugin provides Enter / "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"Shift+Enter and prev/next buttons with wrap-around, centering each match in view.
- **Highlighting m"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ust not fight React**: the transcript DOM is React-owned and re-renders continuously during streamin"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"g. Instead of wrapping matches in `<mark>` nodes (which would mutate React-managed text and break re"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"conciliation), the plugin paints ranges through the CSS Custom Highlight API — an overlay that survi"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ves every re-render and needs zero DOM cleanup."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Ctrl/Cmd+F** opens the floating search bar (only when a conversation is rendered — otherwise the"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" browser's native find stays untouched); **Esc** closes it from anywhere, including while the input "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"holds focus.
- Matching across every rendered chat node: user messages, assistant text, tool cards, "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"and paged-in history. Two toggles mirror the browser/IDE find bar: **Aa** (match case) and **ab** (w"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"hole word) — essential for hunting error codes, function names, and API identifiers.
- Live `n / tot"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"al` counter with **Enter** (next) / **Shift+Enter** (previous) navigation and wrap-around; **F3** / "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"**Ctrl+G** work too, the browser/IDE find-bar convention.
- **Query history**: **ArrowUp** / **Arrow"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"Down** cycle through your recent queries (most recent first, deduplicated), restoring the draft you "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"were typing when you walk back past the newest entry.
- Zero-result queries answer back: the count t"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"urns red, the bar border follows, and the bar gives a one-shot shake (honoring `prefers-reduced-moti"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"on`). Repeated Enter on no results re-shakes instead of staying silent.
- The active match is painte"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"d in a stronger color and scrolled into view automatically.
- The header action button mirrors the o"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"pen state (`aria-pressed`), so you always know whether search is active.
- **Streaming-aware**: a Mu"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"tationObserver re-runs the search (debounced) while output streams or older pages load, without stea"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"ling your scroll position. The active match is anchored by identity (text node + offset), so a paged"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"-in older page or a streamed delta never jumps your cursor to a different occurrence.
- Scope discip"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"line: the composer seat and the plugin's own bar are excluded, so your draft text never produces pha"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"ntom hits.
- Follows the harness theme through `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens; Chinese/English UI pic"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"ked from the document language.
- Session header action button (search icon) registered through the "},{"id":"p8s20","text":"`conversation.session.header.actions` slot — the additive, unload-safe composition route."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Requires Node.js ≥ 22 and pnpm (`npm install -g pnpm`) — `dsh plugin add` installs the bundle into t"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"he profile with pnpm."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### One-liner"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> Common follow-ups: upgrade `dsh plugin upgrade dsh-conv-search --profile web`; uninstall `dsh plug"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"in remove dsh-conv-search --profile web`; local-path install `dsh plugin add ./dsh-conv-search --pro"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"dsh-conv-search --profile web`; local-path install `dsh plugin add ./dsh-conv-search --profile web`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (mounts the host registration row) and `dsh.client` (serves "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"the browser half at `/plugins/<id>/client.js`). `lib/` is committed, so the GitHub tarball installs "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"without a build step."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Verify the mount:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Gesture | Action |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `Ctrl/Cmd+F` (or the header search icon) | Open the search bar |
| Type | Search as you type (120 "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ms debounce) |
| `Enter` / `F3` / `Ctrl/Cmd+G` | Next match (wraps) |
| `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+F3` /"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+G` | Previous match (wraps) |
| `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` | Browse previous queries |"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"
| `Aa` / `ab` buttons | Match case / whole word |
| `Esc` | Close and clear all highlights |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `src/client/engine.ts` — pure DOM helpers: text-node walk, case-insensitive range matching, `CSS.h"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ighlights` paint (`dsh-conv-search` for all matches, `dsh-conv-search-active` for the focused one), "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"and scroll-into-view. No cordis, no React — unit-testable against jsdom.
- `src/client/controller.ts"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"` — the floating bar (plain DOM, so it never couples to the shell's React version), keyboard capture"},{"id":"p21s5","text":", debounced search passes, and the transcript MutationObserver that keeps highlights honest during s"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"treaming.
- `src/client/index.ts` — the cordis client half: installs the controller through `ctx.eff"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ect` and registers the header action button via `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.session.header.actio"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"ns', ...)`, so the button appears and disappears with the slot declaration and plugin fiber.
- `src/"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"index.ts` — the host half is an empty registration shell; all behavior is browser-side."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"None. The plugin only reads the rendered transcript in the browser; it touches no prompt, message, s"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"chema, stream, tool, or provider request."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Matching is plain-text only — no regex, no diacritic folding, no cross-node phrase matching (a phr"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ase split across styled spans will not match).
- Requires a browser with the CSS Custom Highlight AP"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"I (Chrome/Edge 105+, Safari 17.2+, Firefox 132+). On unsupported browsers the bar still counts match"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"es but paints no highlight.
- The bar position is fixed (`top: 64px; right: 24px`); it is not dragga"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ble yet.
- Search scope is the active conversation column only — sidebar session titles and settings"},{"id":"p28s6","text":" pages are intentionally out of scope."}],"truncated":true}
